topics.name: Free wedding website builders
topics.description: Couples looking for free or affordable wedding website platforms. Comparing features, templates, ease of use across free options.

topics.name: Digital wedding invitations
topics.description: Online invitations and save-the-dates — design, etiquette, cost savings vs print, platform options.

topics.name: Wedding website platform comparisons
topics.description: Head-to-head comparisons of wedding website builders — The Knot vs Zola vs WithJoy vs Say I Do. Features, pricing, templates, reviews.

topics.name: Wedding RSVP and guest management
topics.description: Online RSVP tools, guest list tracking, dietary requirements, seating planners, plus-one management.

topics.name: Wedding planning for beginners
topics.description: Checklists, timelines, budgeting tips, and general how-to guidance for couples just starting to plan.

topics.name: Planning a wedding on a budget
topics.description: Cost-saving strategies, free tools, DIY approaches, prioritizing spend. Say I Do's free tier is a natural fit.

topics.name: Non-traditional and alternative weddings
topics.description: Elopements, intimate ceremonies, destination weddings, unconventional formats — and the flexible tools that support them.

topics.name: Wedding photo sharing and guest experience
topics.description: Apps and tools for guests to share photos, live albums, day-of coordination, and post-wedding galleries.

topics.name: Alternatives to The Knot and Zola
topics.description: People actively looking for alternatives to the dominant wedding platforms — either because of cost, design limitations, or feature gaps.

topics.name: Save the dates and wedding stationery
topics.description: Digital save-the-dates, when to send them, etiquette, design trends, print vs digital.
